title: Minimal-polynomial properties in a finite algebra
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $B$ be a nontrivial unital $K$-algebra (a ring with a specified unital homomorphism from $K$ into its center), spanned by finitely many elements as a $K$-vector space. For every $b\in B$, its minimal polynomial $p_b\in K[Z]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], the monic polynomial of least degree vanishing at $b$, exists, is monic of positive degree, and satisfies $p_b(b)=0$. For every $f\in K[Z]$ with $f(b)=0$, one has $p_b\mid f$.
